stories.headline: Cargo ship attacked near Oman; UN pauses Hormuz evacuation as oil jumps 2%

key_facts.fact: A cargo ship was struck by an 'unknown projectile' 7.5 nautical miles (14km) southeast of Oman's port of Dahit on Thursday June 25, damaging its bridge with no casualties reported.
key_facts.excerpt: The British maritime security agency UKMTO reported on Thursday that a ship had been struck 7.5 nautical miles southeast of Oman's port of Dahit by 'an unknown projectile'. No casualties were reported.

key_facts.fact: The UN's International Maritime Organization paused its plan to evacuate more than 11,000 stranded seafarers and around 600 ships from the Strait of Hormuz after the attack; some 57 ships carrying ~1,100 seafarers had passed through under the plan as of Thursday morning.
key_facts.excerpt: The International Maritime Organization announced a plan earlier this week to evacuate around 11,000 seafarers from the region... As of Thursday morning, data from the U.N. shipping agency showed some 57 ships carrying an estimated 1,100 seafarers had passed through the strait under the plan.

key_facts.fact: The attacked vessel was the Singapore-flagged container ship Ever Lovely, owned by Evergreen, which did not transit under the IMO evacuation framework and continued through the strait.
key_facts.excerpt: Maritime risk management firm Vanguard said the ship, the Singapore-flagged Ever Lovely, continued through the strait despite the attack... the vessel that was attacked 'did not transit under IMO's evacuation framework'.

key_facts.fact: A US official told MS Now that Iran was behind the attack; Iran's military had warned vessels against using the southern route approved by the IMO.
key_facts.excerpt: The pause follows a container ship being struck by an unknown projectile near the coast of Oman on Thursday, with a U.S. official telling MS Now that Iran was behind the attack.

key_facts.fact: Oil rose more than 2% on Thursday June 25: Brent settled up $1.52 (2.1%) at $75.26 a barrel and WTI rose $1.58 (2.3%) to $71.92; US gasoline futures jumped about 5%.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent futures rose $1.52, or 2.1%, to settle at $75.26 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude rose $1.58, or 2.3%, to settle at $71.92. ... U.S. gasoline futures jumped about 5%, while U.S. diesel gained about 4%.

key_facts.fact: On Wednesday both crude benchmarks had closed at their lowest since February 27, the day before the war began, after Hormuz shipments rose to their highest since the start of the conflict.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, both crude benchmarks closed at their lowest since February 27, the day before the war began as crude shipments through the strait rose to their highest since the start of the war.

stories.headline: EU gives final approval to US trade pact, locking in 15% tariff on its exports

key_facts.fact: The European Council on Thursday June 25 gave final approval to the EU-US trade pact, removing remaining EU customs duties on US industrial goods in exchange for a 15% tariff on European exports.
key_facts.excerpt: The European Union (EU) on Thursday gave its final approval to the trade pact with the US, thereby removing the remaining customs duties on US industrial goods in exchange for a 15 percent tariff on European exports.

key_facts.fact: The deal formalizes the framework von der Leyen and Trump reached a year ago and will enter into force once published in the EU Official Journal, expected before July 4, the deadline Trump set with a threat to raise tariffs.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement will enter into force once it is published in the Official Journal of the EU, a procedure expected to be completed in the coming days, before July 4, the deadline set by Trump, who has threatened to raise tariffs if the EU fails to meet the deadline.

key_facts.fact: The 15% ceiling replaces the 25% tariff Trump had intended to impose; the EU added safeguards to suspend the deal if the US imposes tariffs above 15% on steel and aluminum derivatives by Dec 31, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The EU has granted tariff preferences to the US in exchange for Trump accepting a 15 percent tariff on European products, instead of the 25 percent he had intended to impose... The agreement may also be suspended if, by Dec. 31, 2026, the US imposes a tariff exceeding 15 percent on products derived from steel and aluminum.

key_facts.fact: The EU also extended tariff suspension to lobster imports and granted preferential access to certain US seafood and non-sensitive agricultural products; the agreement is set to terminate Dec 31, 2029 unless renewed.
key_facts.excerpt: The bloc is also extending the tariff suspension to lobster imports and granting preferential access to other types of US seafood and non-sensitive agricultural products... the EU has decided to terminate the agreement on Dec. 31, 2029.

key_facts.fact: The Council adopted two regulations linked to the EU-US Joint Statement of August 21, 2025, completing the bloc's legislative process.
key_facts.excerpt: In a statement, the [Council] adopted the two regulations linked to the EU-US Joint Statement of August 21, 2025, completing the bloc's legislative process.

stories.headline: NATO's Rutte says alliance will unveil tens of billions in defense contracts at Ankara summit

key_facts.fact: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte said Thursday June 25 the alliance will announce 'tens of billions of dollars' in new defense contracts at the July 7-8 summit in Ankara, Turkey.
key_facts.excerpt: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte said Thursday that the alliance will unveil tens of billions of dollars in new defense contracts at next month's summit in Turkiye's capital, Ankara... 'We will announce tens of billions of dollars of new contracts,' he said.

key_facts.fact: Rutte said allies are on a 'trajectory' to reach the defense spending goal agreed last year of 5% of GDP by 2035, with the summit focused on delivering on pledges.
key_facts.excerpt: The summit will underscore that after years of underinvestment, allies are on a 'trajectory' to reaching a defense spending goal agreed upon last year of 5% of GDP by 2035, said Rutte.

key_facts.fact: The draft summit declaration is expected to confirm 70 billion euros in military aid for Ukraine, with at least the same amount pledged for the following year, without US participation.
key_facts.excerpt: In the draft statement, allies are expected to confirm 70 billion euros in military aid for Ukraine and pledge at least the same amount for the following year. The United States will not take part in this funding.

key_facts.fact: The declaration will reaffirm Article 5, again describe Russia as a long-term threat, and call on Iran to ensure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz as an 'olive branch' to Trump.
key_facts.excerpt: the draft declaration will reaffirm allies' commitment to Article 5 on collective defense and again describe Russia as a long-term threat... allies call on Iran to ensure freedom of navigation in this key trade route. Diplomats describe this as an 'olive branch' to Trump.

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky will attend the summit, which will reaffirm NATO's support for Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy will attend the summit, which will reaffirm NATO's support for Ukraine in its more than four-year-old battle against Russian occupation forces.

stories.headline: California launches first US tracker linking AI exposure to unemployment claims

key_facts.fact: California launched the California AI-Unemployment Tracker (CAIT) on June 25, a first-in-the-nation tool linking unemployment-insurance claims with measures of occupational AI exposure, updated monthly.
key_facts.excerpt: A new, first-in-the-nation tracker launched today in California... The California AI-Unemployment Tracker (CAIT) links unemployment insurance (UI) claims with measures of occupational AI exposure to monitor labor market changes as they unfold.

key_facts.fact: As of May 2026, researchers found no evidence of a statewide surge in layoffs among workers in highly AI-exposed occupations.
key_facts.excerpt: as of May 2026 there is no evidence of a statewide surge in layoffs among workers in highly AI-exposed occupations, though early signs of disruption are emerging among specific groups of workers, industries, and regions.

key_facts.fact: Early signs of disruption emerged: UI claims rose among college-educated workers in high-AI-exposure occupations and among high-exposure workers in the San Francisco Bay Area.
key_facts.excerpt: Unemployment insurance claims rose among college-educated workers in occupations with high exposure to AI, as well as those in occupations with high AI exposure in the San Francisco Bay area.

key_facts.fact: The tracker was developed by Gov. Newsom's office, the Employment Development Department, and the nonpartisan California Policy Lab at UCLA, under a May executive order on AI workforce disruption.
key_facts.excerpt: The California AI-Unemployment Tracker was developed with the California Policy Lab at UCLA and the Employment Development Department... Newsom issued an executive order in May aimed at preparing California workers, small businesses and communities for potential job disruption driven by AI.

key_facts.fact: More than 121,000 tech workers have been laid off this year per a global tracker run by startup founder Roger Lee, though not all of those layoffs are AI-related.
key_facts.excerpt: This year alone, more than 121,000 tech workers have been laid off, according to a global tracker from startup founder Roger Lee. While not all of those layoffs are AI-related, behemoths like Meta, Cisco and Microsoft have laid off thousands.

stories.headline: Binance to halt crypto services for EU clients from July 1 after MiCA license setback

key_facts.fact: Binance said Thursday June 25 it will suspend services in several European countries from next week after failing to secure regulatory approval to operate in the EU before the June 30 MiCA deadline.
key_facts.excerpt: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said Thursday it will suspend services in several European countries from next week as it has been unable secure regulatory approval to operate in the European Union.

key_facts.fact: Binance told clients it had withdrawn its MiCA license application in Greece (the Hellenic Capital Market Commission) and would apply in another EU country, not yet named.
key_facts.excerpt: Binance has withdrawn its MiCA license application in Greece and confirmed it will seek authorization in a different EU member state... The target jurisdiction remains undisclosed.

key_facts.fact: 'Binance France is no longer in a position to accept new clients and from July 1, 2026, will no longer [provide] crypto asset services in France,' it told clients; similar emails were sent to other affected EU markets.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Binance France is no longer in a position to accept new clients and from July 1, 2026, will no longer crypto asset services in France,' the company said in an email to clients on Wednesday. 'This is not specific to France, similar communications have been sent to affected users in other EU markets.'

key_facts.fact: Gillian Lynch, Binance's head of Europe and the UK, told Reuters the exchange is 'not leaving Europe' and would pursue authorization in another EU jurisdiction.
key_facts.excerpt: Gillian Lynch, Binance's head of Europe and the United Kingdom, told Reuters that the exchange is 'not leaving Europe' and would pursue authorization in another EU jurisdiction.

key_facts.fact: ESMA said unauthorized crypto firms must immediately stop onboarding new EU clients, halt marketing, and limit services to closing positions when the MiCA transition ends July 1, with possible coordinated enforcement after.
key_facts.excerpt: Unauthorized firms must immediately stop onboarding new EU clients, halt marketing activity, and limit services to what is necessary for clients to sell, transfer, or close positions. ESMA said national regulators could take coordinated enforcement action.

stories.headline: Bumble explores sale with Morgan Stanley as dating-app growth slows

key_facts.fact: Dating app Bumble is exploring a sale amid slowing growth in online dating and is working with Morgan Stanley on a potential sale process, according to three people familiar with the matter; no deal is certain.
key_facts.excerpt: Dating app Bumble is exploring a sale amid slowing growth in the online dating sector, according to three people familiar with the matter. The company... is working with investment bankers at Morgan Stanley on a potential sale process.

key_facts.fact: Total paying users fell more than 11% in full-year 2025 to about 3.7 million, while annual revenue declined nearly 10% to about $966 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Total paying users fell more than 11 per cent in the full year 2025 to about 3.7 million, while annual revenue declined nearly 10 per cent to about US$966-million.

key_facts.fact: In the first quarter of 2026, paying users dropped about 20% year-on-year after the company trimmed lower-engagement accounts.
key_facts.excerpt: In the first quarter of 2026, paying users dropped by about 20 per cent year-on-year as the company trimmed lower-engagement accounts.

key_facts.fact: Asset manager Blackstone owns about 22% of Bumble, according to LSEG data, and declined to comment.
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley and asset manager Blackstone, which owns about 22% of Bumble according to LSEG data, declined to comment.

stories.headline: Otsuka's centanafadine meets primary endpoint in Phase 3b ADHD-with-anxiety trial

key_facts.fact: Otsuka announced positive topline Phase 3b results on June 25 for centanafadine XR 280 mg once daily in adults with ADHD and comorbid anxiety, meeting the primary endpoint with statistically significant and clinically relevant improvement in ADHD symptoms versus placebo.
key_facts.excerpt: Study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating statistically significant and clinically relevant improvements in ADHD symptoms in adults with ADHD and comorbid anxiety taking centanafadine compared to those taking placebo.

key_facts.fact: Centanafadine is a first-in-class norepinephrine, dopamine, and serotonin reuptake inhibitor (NDSRI).
key_facts.excerpt: Centanafadine is a first-in-class norepinephrine, dopamine, and serotonin reuptake inhibitor (NDSRI).

key_facts.fact: The drug is under FDA Priority Review for ADHD in children, adolescents and adults, with a PDUFA target action date of July 24, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Centanafadine is currently under Priority Review by the FDA for the treatment of ADHD in children, adolescents, and adults, with a target action date of July 24, 2026.
